|quest_reward4_act = 6 |quest_reward4_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Elemental Hit''' is an [[melee]] [[attack]] [[skill]] that randomly deals [[fire]], [[cold]], or [[lightning]] damage in an [[area of effect]] around the target with each use. That use of Elemental Hit will only deal damage of the chosen element, and has more [[area of effect]] against enemies affected by the elemental [[ailment|ailments]] of that element. The skill deals more damage for each elemental [[ailment]] present on enemies. ==Skill functions and interactions== Elemental Hit can be used with any [[melee weapon]] or while [[unarmed]]. *'''Random damage type''': Elemental Hit chooses a random [[element]]s each time it is used. That use can deal '''only''' damage of the chosen element (meaning it can never deal physical or chaos damage). The unique [[threshold jewel]]s [[Combat Focus]] can be used to exclude elements from being chosen. The skill will never choose the same element twice in a row, unless forced to with two [[Combat Focus]] jewels. * Repeats: If the skill is repeated (e.g. with {{il|Multistrike Support}}), it will use the same element for each repeat. *The chosen element also limits damaging ailments. For example, allocating [[Shaper of Flames]] and a chosen cold attack will not result in a damaging ignite. *{{c|mod|80% more Area Radius against Enemies affected by an Ailment of the chosen Element}}: The relevant elemental ailments are [[ignite]] and [[scorch]] (Fire); [[chill]], [[freeze]], and [[brittle]] (Cold); and [[shock]] and [[sap]] (Lightning). *{{c|mod|10% more Damage per Elemental Ailment on the Enemy}}: This modifier only applies once per each unique ailment, up to 70%. Multiple stacks of the same ailment (e.g. two ignites via {{il|Emberwake}}) do not provide additional benefits.. *'''Area damage''': When Elemental Hit's hits an enemy, it creates an AoE that deals damage to other enemies within a base [[radius]] of 1 metre. This area damage cannot damage the enemy it was created from. *'''Damage conversion''': Elemental Hit has added damage of each element present on the gem. This flat damage applies even if it isn't of the chosen element, and in that case it's only negated after [[damage conversion]] has applied. **'''Example''': If the player equips {{il|Call of the Brotherhood}} with 20% elemental quality from a [[catalyst]], supports Elemental Hit with {{il|Cold to Fire Support}}, and allocates the [[keystone]] [[Avatar of Fire]], 50% of the lightning damage will be converted to fire and 48% to cold. Then 100% of the cold damage, both native and converted from lightning, will be converted to fire. When Elemental Hit chooses fire, it will then deal significantly more damage than if the player did not perform damage conversion. * '''Dual Wielding''': Elemental Hit will alternate weapons while [[dual wielding]]. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Fire
